about: Reviewed QA hits that may pass the region runner's gates (scripts/22_run_region.py, pixelphilly.region_runner). A needle matches an entry by id within one of its areas, or by position (within match_m meters, by lon/lat) and height (within match_h_m) in any area, since structure ids (s<region>-<part>) are renumbered per area. Alignment entries name one frame of one area. Add an entry only after checking the hit against the 2024 aerial; say what was checked in note.

needles.note: 6.5-8.8 m², 51 m part kept because it matches the footprint's 49 m typical City height (approx_hgt 161 ft) while most of the footprint measures 13 m; the aerial is inconclusive (CHANGELOG Oct. 22; README Open issues).

Delaware River bulk-unloading crane at the terminal near 39.9163,-75.1263: a LiDAR structure with no footprint, 33 m², 41 m. Checked on the 2024 aerial Oct. 27: the crane's boom and machinery house are there (Stephen shown).

Truss portal on the elevated Walt Whitman Bridge approach over the Packer Ave terminal: a LiDAR structure (7 m², 46 m) at the green steel portal frame visible in the 2024 aerial. Real structure; the deck itself is masked as highway.

Elevated water tower, a green tank on legs with a long shadow in the 2024 aerial. It's a real tall object, and its 40.6 m matches the City record of 137 ft (output/review/lower_northeast_needle_21880.jpg).
